action.name: Magic Bolt
entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 6}，射程 120 呎，單一目標。{@h}16（{@damage 3d10}）火焰傷害。

trait.name: Wielder Domination
entries: 生物對活化法杖成功通過擒抱檢定即可從空中抓住它，且擒抱活化法杖不會降低該生物的速度。任何成功擒抱活化法杖的生物必須成功通過一次 {@dc 12} 魅力豁免檢定，否則被活化法杖{@condition charmed||魅惑}，直到活化法杖不再被它握住為止。該生物被{@condition charmed||魅惑}期間，活化法杖可以對它下達命令，該生物會盡力服從。該生物每次受到傷害時可以重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所受的效應。成功抵抗活化法杖控制的生物在 24 小時內無法被它{@condition charmed||魅惑}。
握持活化法杖且未被它{@condition charmed||魅惑}的生物可以使用一個動作，嘗試在膝蓋上或堅硬表面上折斷活化法杖，成功通過一次 {@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可辦到。以此方式折斷活化法杖會將它摧毀。

action.name: Staff of Frost
entries: 活化法杖有 10 發充能。它可以消耗 1 發或更多充能來施展下列法術之一（豁免 {@dc 12}）：{@spell cone of cold||寒冰錐}（5 發充能）、{@spell fog cloud||雲霧術}（1 發充能）、{@spell ice storm||冰風暴}（4 發充能）或{@spell wall of ice||冰牆術}（4 發充能）。它每天黎明時恢復 {@dice 1d6 + 4} 發已消耗的充能。若活化法杖消耗了最後一發充能，擲一顆 {@dice d20}。擲出 1 時，活化法杖會化為水並被摧毀。

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 5}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}7（{@damage 2d6}）鈍擊傷害外加 1 點寒冰傷害。

items.name: Spider Climb
entries: The statue can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 6}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}11（{@damage 2d8 + 2}）鈍擊傷害。

action.name: Belch Fire {@recharge 4}
entries: 活化爐灶向 15 呎錐形範圍噴吐火焰。該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 22（{@damage 4d10}）火焰傷害，成功則傷害減半。

items.name: Wand of Wonder
entries: The animated wand can expend 1 of its charges and target a random creature with one of its {@item wand of wonder||randomly determined effects}. Any such effect that would target the wand's user targets the wand instead. If reduced to 0 hit points, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 阿克圖莉亞是 18 級施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 20}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 12}）。阿克圖莉亞可以隨意施展{@spell alter self||變造自身}，並準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell Melf's acid arrow||馬友夫強酸箭}

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: 艾許泰蘭索的施法屬性是魅力。它可以天生施展下列法術，無需材料構材：

items.name: Fused Form
entries: As a bonus action, Berlain can use her extra mouth and arms to cast any cantrip she has prepared.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 貝蘭是一名 18 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 17}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 9}）。貝蘭可以隨意施展{@spell disguise self||易容術}與隱形術，並準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}

footerEntries: *貝蘭會在戰鬥前對自己施展這些法術。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 大索爾石怪進行三次爪擊攻擊與一次啃咬攻擊。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 8}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}22（{@damage 5d6 + 5}）穿刺傷害。

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 8}，觸及 10 呎，單一目標。{@h}9（{@damage 1d8 + 5}）劈砍傷害。

items.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. A creature hit by a bullywug's Spear attack must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way is also {@condition paralyzed}. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: 鑽地蠕蟲可以用其掘穴速度的一半鑽過堅硬的岩石，並在身後留下一條直徑 10 呎的隧道。

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: 鑽地蠕蟲若至少有 1 點生命值，便在其每個回合開始時恢復 10 點生命值。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 鑽地蠕蟲進行兩次攻擊：一次碾磨顎與一次螫刺。

action.name: Grinding Jaws
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 10 呎，單一目標。{@h}22（{@damage 3d8 + 9}）劈砍傷害。

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 14}，觸及 10 呎，單一生物。{@h}19（{@damage 3d6 + 9}）穿刺傷害，且目標必須進行一次 {@dc 19} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 42（{@damage 12d6}）毒素傷害，成功則傷害減半。

items.name: Tied Down
entries: While lashed to the floor, the creature is {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained}. It also suffers from two levels of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 此生物進行兩次攻擊：一次觸手與一次啃咬。

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 8}，觸及 10 呎，單一生物。{@h}4（{@damage 1d4 + 2}）毒素傷害，且目標必須成功通過一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定，否則{@condition poisoned||中毒} 1 分鐘。在此毒素結束之前，目標處於{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態。目標可以在其每個回合結束時重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所中的毒。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 4}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}7（{@damage 2d4 + 2}）穿刺傷害。

items.name: Special Equipment
entries: Cassiok carries a {@item staff of power} that grants him a +2 bonus to Armor Class, spell attack rolls, and saving throws. His insectoid physiology prevents him from making melee attacks with the staff. If reduced to 20 hit points or fewer, Cassiok uses his next action to break his staff in a retributive strike.

ac.condition: 使用{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}時

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 卡西奧克是一名 18 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 19}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 11}）。卡西奧克可以隨意施展{@spell disguise self||易容術}與隱形術，並準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}

footerEntries: *卡西奧克會在戰鬥前對自己施展這些法術。

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 3}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}5（{@damage 1d8 + 1}）劈砍傷害。

items.name: Illumination
entries: The golem magically sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This light goes out when the golem is destroyed.

items.name: Light Intensity
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the illuminated golem and can see the golem must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of the creature's next turn.

A creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the golem until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the golem in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

items.name: Third Arm
entries: The duergar can make an attack with its javelin as a bonus action.

items.name: Two Heads
entries: The duergar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

items.name: Warp Reality
entries: As a bonus action on her turn, Dezmyr can warp reality, undoing damage dealt to herself or another creature that she can see within 20 feet of her. The beneficiary of this warped reality instantly regains 10 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 黛茲米爾是一名 19 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是魅力（法術豁免 {@dc 18}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 10}）。它準備了下列聖騎士法術：

items.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
entries: Drivvin magically summons a {@filter demon of challenge rating 6 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|tag=demon|miscellaneous=!swarm}. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of him, acts as his ally, and can't summon other demons. The summoned demon remains until Drivvin dismisses it as an action or until the demon is reduced to 0 hit points.

items.name: Hurl Fire
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) fire damage.

items.name: Special Equipment
entries: Ezzat wears an {@item amulet of proof against detection and location}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 艾札特是 18 級施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 20}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 12}）。它準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell Melf's acid arrow||馬友夫強酸箭}
{@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes six attacks: one with its bite and five with its claws.

items.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Magic Missile
entries: 飛行魔杖向它 60 呎內它能偵測到的一個生物射出一枚魔法力場飛鏢。飛鏢必定命中，目標受到 3（{@damage 1d4 + 1}）力場傷害。

items.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the mummy lord magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the mummy lord is Large, doubles its damage dice with its Rotting Fist attack, and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the mummy lord lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

items.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The mummy lord magically turns {@condition invisible} for up to 1 hour or until it attacks, it casts a spell, it uses its Enlarge, or its {@status concentration} is broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the mummy lord wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

The stalagmite in the northwest alcove is hollow and serves as Gorka Tharn's sarcophagus. The mummy lord is lodged inside the stalagmite's funnel-shaped interior. When it awakens, the mummy lord uses a {@spell stone shape} spell to create an opening large enough for it to emerge. It destroys any intruders in its lair, then returns to its sarcophagus and its slumber.

At the bottom of the stalagmite's hollow cavity, four 1-foot-tall clay urns contain Gorka Tharn's preserved internal organs, including the mummy lord's shriveled heart. Only by destroying the heart can the characters prevent the mummy lord from rejuvenating. The heart is a Tiny object with AC 5, 25 hit points, and immunity to all damage except fire.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 木乃伊領主是一名 10 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是感知（法術豁免 {@dc 17}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 9}）。木乃伊領主準備了下列牧師法術：

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The troglodyte makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its longsword.

items.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

ac.condition: 使用{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}時

resist.note: (granted by the blast scepter, see "Special Equipment" below)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 哈拉斯特是一名 20 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 22}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 14}）。他可以隨意施展{@spell disguise self||易容術}與{@spell invisibility||隱形術}。他可以不消耗法術位各施展一次{@spell fly||飛行術}與{@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}，但完成短休或長休前無法再次這麼做。哈拉斯特準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: 哈拉斯特穿著一件{@item robe of eyes||百眼法袍}，讓他能看見所有方向、獲得 120 呎黑暗視覺、在依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上具有優勢，並能看見 120 呎內{@condition invisible||隱形}的生物與物件，以及乙太位面。
哈拉斯特持有一根{@item blast scepter|WDMM|爆破權杖}（一件需要同調的極稀有魔法物品）。它可以當作奧術法器使用。與爆破權杖同調者獲得對火焰與閃電傷害的抗性，並可以用一個動作使用它以 4 環法術施展{@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}（豁免 {@dc 16}），無需消耗法術位。
哈拉斯特還戴著一枚有角戒指（一件需要同調的極稀有魔法物品），讓同調的配戴者得以無視地底山的魔法限制（見「魔法的變動」）。

trait.name: Arcane Recovery (1/Day)
entries: 完成一次短休時，哈拉斯特恢復他所有 5 環及以下的法術位。

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: 若哈拉斯特豁免檢定失敗，他可以選擇改為成功。

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: 若哈拉斯特在地底山中死亡，他會在 {@dice 1d10} 天後復活，生命值全滿，任何失去的身體部位也會復原。他的新身體會出現在地底山中一處隨機的安全地點。

action.name: Blast Scepter
entries: 哈拉斯特使用他的爆破權杖以 4 環法術施展{@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}。以他為起點的 15 呎立方範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 16} 體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗的生物受到 {@damage 5d8} 雷鳴傷害並被推離 10 呎。豁免成功的生物只受一半傷害且不會被推離。

legendary.name: Cast Spell
entries: 哈拉斯特施展一個 3 環或更低的法術。

legendary.name: Spell Ward (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: 哈拉斯特消耗一個 4 環或更低的法術位，該法術位每環使他獲得 5 點臨時生命值。
legendary.name_zh: 法術結界（消耗 2 個動作）

items.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The Halaster horror is immune to the {@spell cone of cold}, {@spell disintegrate}, and {@spell fireball} spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 哈拉斯特恐獸進行兩次法杖攻擊。

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 6}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}8（{@damage 1d8 + 4}）鈍擊傷害。

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: 若有人對哈拉斯特傀儡成功施展{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術（{@dc 15}），它便會被摧毀。

trait.name: Salt Sensitivity
entries: 將一磅鹽撒在蝸牛的皮膚上，會對牠造成 {@damage 1d6} 酸蝕傷害。

trait.name: Magical Properties
entries: 使用一個動作觸碰這隻活蝸牛的生物獲得 6 點臨時生命值，持續 24 小時。任何觸碰這隻活蝸牛的生物或物件還會獲得{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術的效益。這隻蝸牛死亡時會失去這些魔法特性。

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: 這隻蝸牛可以攀爬難以攀附的表面，包括倒掛在天花板上，無需進行屬性檢定。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 它可以用一個動作以偽足進行兩次攻擊。

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 7}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}21（{@damage 6d6}）酸蝕傷害，巨型灰泥怪變巨期間則為 42（{@damage 12d6}）酸蝕傷害。若目標穿著非魔法的金屬護甲，該護甲會被部分腐蝕，其提供的 AC 受到永久且可累積的 −1 減值。若減值使護甲的 AC 降至 10，該護甲即被摧毀。

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: 巨型灰泥怪以魔法增大體型，持續 1 分鐘。變巨期間，巨型灰泥怪的體型為超巨型，其偽足攻擊的傷害骰加倍，且進行力量檢定與力量豁免檢定時具有優勢。
action.name_zh: 變巨（短休或長休後充能）
action._zhOf: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: 巨型灰泥怪以魔法變為{@condition invisible||隱形}，持續至多 1 小時，直到它攻擊、使用「變巨」，或其{@status concentration||專注}被打斷為止（如同對法術{@status concentration||專注}）。
action.name_zh: 隱形（短休或長休後充能）
action._zhOf: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

monster.name: Intelligent Black Pudding
languages: Elvish and Undercommon but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: 智慧黑布丁的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 12}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 4}）。它可以施展下列法術，無需任何構材：

1: {@spell Melf's acid arrow||馬友夫強酸箭}

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: 鐵蜘蛛可以攀爬難以攀爬的表面，包括倒掛在天花板上，無需進行屬性檢定。

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: 鐵蜘蛛位於{@spell antimagic field||反魔法結界}的範圍內時處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態。若成為{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}的目標，鐵蜘蛛必須對抗施法者的法術豁免 DC 成功通過一次體質豁免檢定，否則陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷} 1 分鐘。

action.name: Web Cable
entries: 鐵蜘蛛射出一條 6 吋粗、至多 50 呎長的蛛網纜索，將纜索遠端固定在距離它至多 50 呎的堅固表面上。它可以用一個附贈動作將纜索的另一端從自己身上分離，並固定在它 10 呎內的堅固表面上。一旦製造了 200 呎的蛛網纜索，鐵蜘蛛在下個黎明前無法再製造任何纜索。

items.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: The vampire magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of {@creature swarm of bats||bats} or {@creature swarm of rats||rats}, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call {@dice 3d6} {@creature giant centipede||giant centipedes} instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 凱瑞絲塔是一名 9 級的施法者。它的施法屬性是感知（法術豁免 {@dc 15}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 7}）。它準備了下列牧師法術：

items.name: Multiattack
entries: Kol'daan makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or sparring sword.

items.name: Sparring Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Metal Immunity
entries: 熔岩之子可以毫無阻礙地穿過金屬，且對任何穿著金屬護甲或使用金屬盾牌的生物進行攻擊檢定時具有優勢。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 熔岩之子進行兩次攻擊：一次啃咬，以及一次爪擊。

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 6}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}11（{@damage 2d6 + 4}）穿刺傷害。

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 7}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}7（{@damage 1d6 + 4}）劈砍傷害。

monster.name: Living Unseen Servant
languages: understands one language (usually Common) but can't speak

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: 活化隱形僕役處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態。

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 2}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}1 點鈍擊傷害。

items.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Maddgoth's Homunculus

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + 2} piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead {@condition poisoned} for 5 ({@dice 1d10}) minutes and {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

monster.name_zh: 瑪德戈斯的荷蒙庫魯斯

items.name: Blind Eye
entries: Due to poor depth perception, Mobar has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 繆拉爾是 13 級施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 17}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 9}）。它準備了下列法師法術：

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: 若繆拉爾豁免檢定失敗，它可以選擇改為成功。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 繆拉爾進行三次攻擊：兩次長劍，以及一次螫刺。

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}13（{@damage 2d8 + 4}）劈砍傷害，若以雙手使用則為 15（{@damage 2d10 + 4}）劈砍傷害。

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 10 呎，單一生物。{@h}9（{@damage 1d10 + 4}）穿刺傷害。目標必須進行一次 {@dc 16} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 27（{@damage 6d8}）毒素傷害，成功則傷害減半。

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: 繆拉爾施展一個戲法。

legendary.name: Lunging Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: 繆拉爾進行一次觸及為 10 呎的長劍攻擊。
legendary.name_zh: 突刺攻擊（消耗 2 個動作）

legendary.name: Retreating Strike (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: 繆拉爾移動至多等同其速度的距離，且不會引發藉機攻擊。移動之前，他可以進行一次長劍攻擊。
legendary.name_zh: 撤退打擊（消耗 3 個動作）

items.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: 突變卓爾的天生施法屬性是魅力（法術豁免 {@dc 15}）。突變卓爾可以天生施展下列法術，無需材料構材：

items.name: Eye Ray
entries: The zombie uses a random magical eye ray, choosing a target that it can see within 60 feet of it.

items.name: 1. Paralyzing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 2. Fear Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 3. Enervation Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 4. Telekinetic Ray
items.entry: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw, or the zombie moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the zombie's next turn or until the zombie is incapacitated. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The zombie can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or container.

5.with: {@spell Rary's telepathic bond||拉瑞心靈聯結}

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The troglodyte makes two claw attacks.

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + 4} piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The generator makes two fist attacks or four dart attacks.

items.name: Magic Dart
entries: The generator hurls a magic dart at a target it can see up to 60 feet away from it. The dart hits its target automatically (no attack roll required) for 5 ({@damage 2d4}) force damage.

trait.name: Invisible in Water
entries: 毒素水詭完全浸在毒釀中時處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態。

trait.name: Brew Bound
entries: 若被迫離開它棲身的毒釀水盆，或有人對毒釀施展{@spell purify food and drink||淨化飲食}法術，毒素水詭便會死亡。

trait.name: Poisonous Body
entries: 生物被毒素水詭{@condition grappled||擒抱}期間，在其每個回合開始時受到 10（{@damage 3d6}）毒素傷害。

items.name: Shadowfell Despair
entries: Portia suffers from Shadowfell despair manifesting as unshakable dread. Until the despair ends, she has disadvantage on all saving throws and gains the following flaw: "I'm convinced that I'm going to die in Vanrakdoom." Portia can attempt to end her despair each time she finishes a long rest, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. A {@spell calm emotions} spell also ends her despair, as does any spell or other magical effect that removes a curse.

reaction.name: Eye Rays
entries: 普莉塔可以用一個附贈動作或反應，向她 120 呎內她看得見的一個目標射出下列眼球射線之一：

items.name: Fear Ray
items.entry: 目標必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，否則{@condition frightened||恐懼} 1 分鐘。目標可以在它每個回合結束時重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所受的效應。

items.name: Paralyzing Ray
items.entry: 目標必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則{@condition paralyzed||麻痺} 1 分鐘。目標可以在它每個回合結束時重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所受的效應。

spellcasting.name: Lesser Magic
headerEntries: 符文青足龍蛇施展{@spell color spray||七彩噴射}或{@spell sleep||睡眠術}，無需任何構材。它的施法屬性是魅力（法術豁免 {@dc 13}）。

spellcasting.name: Greater Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
headerEntries: 符文青足龍蛇施展{@spell invisibility||隱形術}或{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}，無需任何構材。
spellcasting.name_zh: 高等魔法（消耗 2 個動作）

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: 每當蠍拉達受到閃電傷害時，它不會受到傷害，且其螫刺額外造成 11（{@damage 2d10}）閃電傷害，直到其下個回合結束。

trait.name: Scaladar Link
entries: 蠍拉達知道它 100 呎內其他蠍拉達的位置，並能感知到牠們任何一隻受到傷害。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 蠍拉達進行三次攻擊：兩次爪擊，以及一次螫刺。

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 7}，觸及 10 呎，單一目標。{@h}10（{@damage 1d12 + 4}）鈍擊傷害，且目標陷入{@condition grappled||被擒}狀態（脫逃 {@dc 15}）。蠍拉達有兩隻螯，每隻可以擒抱一個目標。

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 7}，觸及 10 呎，單一目標。{@h}9（{@damage 1d10 + 4}）穿刺傷害外加 11（{@damage 2d10}）閃電傷害。

monster.name: Shadow Assassin
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: 暗影刺客可以穿過窄至 1 吋寬的空間而無需擠身。

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: 處於微光或黑暗中時，暗影刺客可以用一個附贈動作採取{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: 處於陽光下時，暗影刺客在攻擊檢定、屬性檢定與豁免檢定上具有劣勢。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 暗影刺客進行兩次暗影之刃攻擊。

action.name: Shadow Blade
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 8}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}7（{@damage 1d6 + 4}）穿刺傷害外加 10（{@damage 3d6}）死靈傷害。除非目標免疫死靈傷害，否則每次被此攻擊命中時，目標的力量值減少 {@dice 1d4}。若目標的力量降至 0，目標死亡。此降低效果持續到目標完成一次短休或長休為止。若一名非邪惡的類人生物死於此攻擊，{@dice 1d4} 小時後會有一隻陰影（見《怪物圖鑑》）從屍體中升起。

items.name: Shapechanger
entries: The roper can use its action to polymorph into a stone object or back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Disable
entries: 一條腿的生命值降至 0 時即被癱瘓，電擊踐踏者可以使用一個反應將它從主體上分離。每當有一條腿被癱瘓，電擊踐踏者的步行速度減少 10 呎。若七條腿中有四條被癱瘓，整座機關便會傾倒並停止運作。

trait.name: Electrified Surface
entries: 在接觸電擊踐踏者機體（圓盤或砲塔）的狀態下結束回合的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 22（{@damage 4d10}）閃電傷害，成功則傷害減半。

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: 電擊踐踏者免疫任何會改變其形態的法術或效應。

trait.name: Control Module
entries: 位於電擊踐踏者平台上或其上方的生物，成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定或感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定即可找到其控制模組。角色可以用一個動作嘗試打開控制模組的檢修面板：成功通過一次 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定將它扯下，或使用盜賊工具並成功通過一次 {@dc 25} 敏捷檢定將它撬開。面板後方、嵌在控制模組地板中的是一個直徑 5 呎、不斷脈動的水晶半球，AC 10、生命值 25，並免疫毒素與精神傷害。摧毀水晶半球會使電擊踐踏者停止運作。

trait.name: Lightning Turret
entries: 角色可以嘗試用一塊 10 磅重的石頭或類似物件堵住閃電砲塔的噴口，成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可辦到。被堵住的砲塔無法發射閃電，直到有生物使用一個動作嘗試清除堵塞物為止，這需要再成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。電擊踐踏者無法自行清除堵塞物。

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 電擊踐踏者進行三次閃電砲塔攻擊與兩次踐踏攻擊。

action.name: Lightning Turret
entries: 砲塔向電擊踐踏者 60 呎內的一個生物射出一道魔法閃電。目標必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗受到 44（{@damage 8d10}）閃電傷害，成功則傷害減半。

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 8}，觸及 10 呎，單一生物。{@h}22（{@damage 3d10 + 6}）鈍擊傷害。

items.name: Spider Features
entries: While cursed with spider features, Shunn can climb difficult surfaces, even across ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

items.name: Acid Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales acid in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 58 ({@damage 13d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Paralyzing Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Magic Theft
entries: The golem targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw, or all magic items in its possession are teleported to the bottom of the pit in {@adventure area 31|WDMM|15|31. Hall of Embers}.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: Thwad makes three attacks with his maul or his shortbow.

items.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage if Thwad has more than half of his total hit points remaining.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 特倫琪雅是 5 級施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 13}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 5}）。它施展法術時無需姿勢或材料構材。特倫琪雅準備了下列法師法術：

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 特倫琪雅使用閃電射線兩次。

action.name: Fire Ray
entries: {@atk rs} 命中 {@hit 5}，射程 30 呎，單一目標。{@h}10（{@damage 3d6}）閃電傷害。

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: 特羅布里安是 18 級施法者。它的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 20}，法術攻擊命中 {@hit 12}）。它準備了下列法師法術：

spells: {@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}

trait.name: Necrotic Absorption
entries: 每當不死蔓生怪受到死靈傷害時，它不會受到傷害，並恢復等同該死靈傷害的生命值。

4.with: {@spell Otiluke's Resilient Sphere||歐提路克魔封法球}

walk.condition: （蝙蝠或混種形態下攀爬 30 呎、飛行 60 呎）

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: 蝠人可以使用其動作變形為中型的蝙蝠與類人生物混種形態或大型的巨蝙蝠，或變回其類人生物的真實形態。除了體型之外，它在每種形態下的數據都相同。它穿戴或攜帶的任何裝備都不會隨之變形。它死亡時會變回真實形態。

trait.name: Echolocation (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: 只要未陷入{@condition deafened||耳聾}狀態，蝠人便擁有 60 呎盲視。
trait.name_zh: 回聲定位（僅限蝙蝠或混種形態）

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: 蝠人在依賴聽覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上具有優勢。

trait.name: Nimble Escape (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: 蝠人可以在它每個回合用一個附贈動作採取{@action Disengage||撤離}或{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。
trait.name_zh: 靈巧脫逃（僅限類人生物形態）

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: 處於陽光下時，蝠人的攻擊檢定具有劣勢，依賴視覺的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定也具有劣勢。

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: 處於類人生物形態時，蝠人進行兩次彎刀攻擊或兩次短弓攻擊。處於混種形態時，它可以進行一次啃咬攻擊與一次彎刀攻擊。
action.name_zh: 多重攻擊（僅限類人或混合形態）

action.name: Bite (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 5}，觸及 5 呎，單一生物。{@h}6（{@damage 1d6 + 3}）穿刺傷害，且蝠人獲得等同所造成傷害的臨時生命值。若目標是類人生物，它必須成功通過一次 {@dc 10} 體質豁免檢定，否則被詛咒而染上蝠人獸化症。
action.name_zh: 啃咬（僅限蝙蝠或混種形態）

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 5}，觸及 5 呎，單一目標。{@h}6（{@damage 1d6 + 3}）劈砍傷害。
action.name_zh: 彎刀（僅限類人或混合形態）

action.name: Shortbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 5}，射程 80/320 呎，單一目標。{@h}6（{@damage 1d6 + 3}）穿刺傷害。
action.name_zh: 短弓（僅限類人或混合形態）

items.name: Special Equipment
entries: Xarann wears a {@item Piwafwi (Cloak of Elvenkind)|OotA|piwafwi}, a drow-made {@item cloak of elvenkind}. It loses its magic if exposed to sunlight for 1 hour without interruption.

items.name: Special Equipment
entries: Yrlakka carries a {@item Potion of Fire Resistance||potion of resistance (fire)} in a tiny crystal vial fastened to a cord around his right ankle, and he has a {@item wand of magic detection} hanging from his belt.

items.name: Special Equipment
entries: Zalthar wields a {@item nine lives stealer} longsword with 5 charges remaining.

items.name: Nine Lives Stealer Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage, or 12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: 佐拉克在對抗毒素的豁免檢定上具有優勢，並對毒素傷害具有抗性。

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: 若佐拉克不在陽光下或流水中，他可以使用其動作變形為一隻微型蝙蝠或一團中型霧氣，或變回其真實形態。
處於蝙蝠形態時，佐拉克無法說話，步行速度為 5 呎，並擁有 30 呎飛行速度。除了體型與速度之外，它的數據不變。它穿戴的任何東西會隨它一同變形，但它攜帶的東西不會。它死亡時會變回真實形態。
處於霧氣形態時，佐拉克無法採取任何動作、說話或操作物件。它沒有重量，具有 20 呎的飛行速度，可以懸浮，並且可以進入敵對生物的空間並停留在那裡。此外，只要空氣能通過某個空間，霧就能穿過它而無需擠身，但霧無法穿過水。它的力量、敏捷與體質豁免檢定具有優勢，並免疫所有非魔法傷害，但來自陽光的傷害除外。

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: 若佐拉克豁免檢定失敗，他可以選擇改為成功。

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: 佐拉克在安息處以外生命值降至 0 時，只要不在陽光下或流水中，他會化為一團霧氣（如同「變形者」特性）而非陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。若它無法變形，便會被摧毀。
在霧化形態下生命值為 0 時，它無法變回吸血鬼形態，且必須在 2 小時內抵達安息處，否則會被摧毀。一旦進入安息處，它便會變回吸血鬼形態。之後它處於{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態，直到恢復至少 1 點生命值為止。以 0 點生命值在安息處待滿 1 小時後，它恢復 1 點生命值。

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: 若佐拉克至少有 1 點生命值且不在陽光下或流水中，他在其回合開始時恢復 20 點生命值。若佐拉克受到光耀傷害或聖水造成的傷害，此特性在佐拉克的下個回合開始時不會生效。

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: 佐拉克可以攀爬難以攀附的表面，包括倒掛在天花板上，無需進行屬性檢定。

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: 佐拉克有下列弱點：

items.name: Forbiddance
items.entry: 未受任一居住者邀請，佐拉克無法進入住宅。

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
items.entry: 佐拉克若在流水中結束其回合，受到 20 點酸蝕傷害。

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: 若佐拉克在其安息處陷入{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態時被木製穿刺武器刺入心臟，佐拉克會陷入{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態，直到木樁被移除為止。

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.entry: 佐拉克在陽光下開始其回合時，受到 20 點光耀傷害。處於陽光下時，它的攻擊檢定與屬性檢定具有劣勢

action.name: Multiattack
entries: 佐拉克以他的{@item dwarven thrower||矮人飛錘}進行兩次攻擊，其中只有一次可以是遠程攻擊。

action.name: Dwarven Thrower
entries: {@atk mw,rw} 命中 {@hit 12}，觸及 5 呎或射程 20/60 呎，單一目標。{@h}11（{@damage 1d8 + 7}）鈍擊傷害，以雙手使用進行近戰攻擊時則為 12（{@damage 1d10 + 7}）鈍擊傷害。遠程攻擊命中時，此錘額外造成 {@damage 1d8} 鈍擊傷害（若目標是巨人則為 {@damage 2d8}）。{@hom}若被投擲，此武器會在攻擊後飛回佐拉克手中。

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: 佐拉克進行兩次攻擊，其中只有一次可以是啃咬攻擊。
action.name_zh: 多重攻擊（僅限吸血鬼形態）

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 5 呎，單一生物。{@h}8（{@damage 1d8 + 4}）鈍擊傷害。佐拉克可以不造成傷害，改為擒抱目標（脫逃 {@dc 18}）。
action.name_zh: 徒手打擊（僅限吸血鬼形態）

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 5 呎，一個自願的生物，或一個被佐拉克{@condition grappled||擒抱}、陷入{@condition incapacitated||無力}或{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態的生物。{@h}7（{@damage 1d6 + 4}）穿刺傷害外加 10（{@damage 3d6}）死靈傷害。目標的生命值上限減少等同所受死靈傷害的數值，佐拉克則恢復等量的生命值。此減少效應持續到目標完成一次長休為止。若此效應使目標的生命值上限降至 0，它便會死亡。以此方式被殺死並埋入土中的類人生物，會在次日夜晚以受佐拉克控制的{@creature vampire spawn||吸血鬼眷族}之姿復起。
action.name_zh: 啃咬（僅限蝙蝠或吸血鬼形態）

action.name: Charm
entries: 佐拉克以他 30 呎內他看得見的一個類人生物為目標。若目標看得見佐拉克，目標必須成功通過一次對抗此魔法的 {@dc 17} 感知豁免檢定，否則被佐拉克{@condition charmed||魅惑}。被{@condition charmed||魅惑}的目標將佐拉克視為值得聽從與保護的可信摯友。雖然目標並未受佐拉克控制，但它會盡可能以最善意的方式看待佐拉克的請求或行動，並且是佐拉克啃咬攻擊的自願目標。
每當佐拉克或佐拉克的同伴對目標做出任何有害之事時，目標可以重新進行豁免檢定，成功則結束自身所受的效應。否則此效應持續 24 小時，或直到佐拉克被消滅、與目標位於不同的存在位面，或以一個附贈動作結束此效應為止。

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: 只要太陽尚未升起，佐拉克便能以魔法呼喚 {@dice 2d4} 群{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠}或{@creature swarm of rats||老鼠}。在戶外時，佐拉克可以改為呼喚 {@dice 3d6} 隻{@creature wolf||狼}。被呼喚的生物會在 {@dice 1d4} 輪後抵達，作為佐拉克的盟友行動並服從他的口頭命令。這些野獸會停留 1 小時，或直到佐拉克死亡，或佐拉克以一個附贈動作遣散牠們為止。

legendary.name: Move
entries: 佐拉克移動至多等同其速度的距離，且不會引發藉機攻擊。

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: 佐拉克進行一次徒手打擊。

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: 佐拉克進行一次啃咬攻擊。
